set.body: Teach LocalMultivarExecutor to resolve CPCA specs per ROI. Acceptance: selected ROI MatrixView becomes a DualityDiagram; row constraints resolve once against sample space; column constraints resolve against the ROI-local observed space; Cpca.fit is called without changing the core CPCA algebra; sparse/dense policy errors remain explicit.
set.title: CPCA: local ROI executor resolution
